BiblicalUsage: Barley loaves are the food of the miracle. In John 6:9 a lad has five barley loaves and two small fishes, and in John 6:13 the disciples gather twelve baskets of fragments from those same barley loaves after five thousand have eaten.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the barley matters because God chose the poor man's bread for the greatest feast: five loaves were enough when they were in Jesus' hands, and there was more left over than they started with.
